decisions.reason: As a 2023 flagship biodynamic yogurt line with several variants, publicly tied to the firm's direction and still promoted in 2024, it carries high visible commitment and sunk investment, which under escalation of commitment makes withdrawal unlikely.

This 2024 mild sliced cheese is close to the firm's core dairy business and already has its own product page, so management is likely to give it more time and keep it unless clear sustained weakness emerges.

This 2024 sliced butter cheese also fits the established range and has at least moderate launch commitment, so in a growing food market management would more likely persist than quickly admit a mistaken launch.
